land_effect: Extinguished or exchanged many eastern treaty-recognized interests and created western treaty/reservation geographies.

jurisdiction_effect: Defined Indian country for the Act and extended federal criminal and Indian-affairs regulation.
land_effect: Created a federal statutory geography separate from particular treaty lines.

law_name: Indian Appropriations Act (end of treaty making)
jurisdiction_effect: Ended recognition of tribes as independent nations for future treaty-making while preserving existing treaties.
land_effect: Existing treaty obligations remained; no new treaties thereafter.

jurisdiction_effect: Created federal jurisdiction over enumerated major offenses by Indians in Indian country.
land_effect: No boundary alteration; operates within legally defined Indian country.

jurisdiction_effect: Authorized division of communal reservation land into individual allotments and surplus-land disposition.
land_effect: Fragmented reservation land; trust allotments remained legally significant Indian-country land.

jurisdiction_effect: Extended allotment and assimilation policy in Indian Territory and curtailed Five Tribes governmental institutions.
land_effect: Allotted tribal land and prepared surplus dispositions in Indian Territory.

jurisdiction_effect: Authorized early fee patents for competent allottees and subjected recipients to state and county laws.
land_effect: Accelerated conversion of some trust allotments to fee land, deepening checkerboarding.

jurisdiction_effect: Expanded federal administrative control over inheritance, partition, and restrictions affecting allotted land.
land_effect: Affected whether allotments remained restricted/trust or entered fee ownership.

jurisdiction_effect: Conferred U.S. citizenship while preserving property rights; not a broad criminal-jurisdiction transfer.
land_effect: Expressly preserved rights to tribal or other property.

jurisdiction_effect: Ended further allotment, authorized land restoration/acquisition, and enabled tribal constitutions.
land_effect: Stopped new allotment and enabled restoration/acquisition without erasing existing checkerboarding.

jurisdiction_effect: Extended IRA-style organization, land acquisition, and cooperative authority to Oklahoma tribes.
land_effect: Supported acquisition and holding of land for Oklahoma tribes.

jurisdiction_effect: Authorized tribal mineral leasing with federal approval, strengthening tribal resource-administration roles.
land_effect: Applies to tribal lands; does not redraw treaty or reservation boundaries.

jurisdiction_effect: Created a commission to hear claims against the United States, including treaty and land claims.
land_effect: Addressed compensation and claims; generally did not restore land boundaries.

jurisdiction_effect: Codified Indian-country definition and General/Major Crimes framework.
land_effect: Includes individual trust allotments in statutory Indian country.

jurisdiction_effect: Announced termination policy for named tribes and a shift toward state-law treatment.
land_effect: Threatened federal trust/treaty land protections; effects followed specific statutes.

jurisdiction_effect: Transferred or authorized broad state criminal jurisdiction in covered Indian country and withdrew much federal 18 USC 1152/1153 authority.
land_effect: No direct boundary redraw; applies in legally defined Indian country.

jurisdiction_effect: Ended federal supervision/trust relationship for Menominee and placed property/governance under state-law transition.
land_effect: Reservation/trust status was dismantled during termination and later restored by 1973 legislation.

law_name: Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act
jurisdiction_effect: Authorized tribes to contract/compact to administer federal programs, strengthening governmental capacity.
land_effect: No direct redrawing of treaty or reservation boundaries.

jurisdiction_effect: Allocated child-custody jurisdiction and placement preferences to protect tribal interests.
land_effect: Operates by Indian child/tribal membership and reservation domicile, not treaty boundary alone.

land_effect: Applies to Indian lands as statutorily defined, not every treaty-cession area.

land_effect: No direct boundary change; applies through Indian-country/tribal justice geography.

jurisdiction_effect: Recognized special tribal criminal jurisdiction over covered crimes by certain non-Indians, subject to statutory conditions.
land_effect: No direct boundary change; confined to Indian country of participating tribes.
